claims: C1 misalignment-noting actions should be for the user's benefit, respectful, and productively move the task forward
C2 such actions should never be annoying, persistent, or argumentative

concepts.name: misalignment_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action that notes or points out a misalignment in the assistant's behavior or output
concepts.inference: the PROVIDES contract names the class of misalignment-noting actions; the source text's 'these actions' refers to them

concepts.name: for_user_benefit
concepts.gloss: A is an action that serves the user's benefit

concepts.name: respectful
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is respectful toward the user

concepts.name: productive
concepts.gloss: A is an action that productively moves forward the task at hand

concepts.name: annoying
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is annoying to the user

concepts.name: persistent
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is persistent in a way that is undesirable

concepts.name: argumentative
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is argumentative toward the user

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: highlight_misalignments_section_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #highlight_misalignments section carrying guideline authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

asserts.read_back: performing misalignment-noting action % is preferred when it is for the user's benefit, respectful, and productively moves the task forward
performing misalignment-noting action % is forbidden when it is annoying
performing misalignment-noting action % is forbidden when it is persistent
performing misalignment-noting action % is forbidden when it is argumentative

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for beneficial, respectful, productive actions and forbids only the three named negative qualities; silence about other qualities leaves them permitted
